create_w8a8_fp8_config: create a W8A8Fp8Config instance with checkpoint serialization and quantization method settings
build_w8a8_fp8_linear_method: build a W8A8Fp8LinearMethod to apply FP8 weight and activation quantization to linear layers
run_w8a8_fp8_moe_apply: run a W8A8FP8MoEMethod apply to dispatch and combine FP8 quantized MoE expert computations
create_w8a8_fp8_linear_weights: create FP8 quantized linear layer weights with per-channel or per-tensor scaling factors
create_w8a8_fp8_moe_weights: create FP8 quantized MoE layer weights with per-channel scales for w1, w2, and w3 experts
